sentences.text: And In the matter of : Manas Rana ...... petitioner Mr. Soumyajit Das Mahapatra, Ms. Madhurai Sinha ....for the petitioner Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, Ld. P.P. Mr. Aniket Mitra ....for the State Petitioner claims that, the de facto complainant left the matrimonial home voluntarily.

sentences.text: Learned advocate appearing for the State draws attention of the Court to the materials in the case diary including statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 of the Criminal Procedure Code.
sentences._hearing_file: Manas Rana vs Unknown on 20 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: Considering the materials in the case diary and considering the nature of incident and considering the fact that the de facto complainant claimed assault while there is no injury report in the case diary, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
sentences._hearing_file: Manas Rana vs Unknown on 20 March, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on further condition that the petitioner shall meet the Investigating Officer once in a fortnight till the conclusion of investigation and on condition that the petitioner shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
This application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed.
(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
